I had tried Amanita once before by eating a cap every hour for three hours and everything was very mellow for me. I made the mistake on my second experience to go into the public on a trip.
I made the mistake on my second experience to go into the public on a trip.
I ate 6 caps and was in line for a concert. An hour had passed and I returned to my vehicle to ingest one more large cap. I entered the venue and after some time I could not handle that I was the only one in this state of mind. I talked to a couple about the magic ODIN and the runes and his plant material the Amanita. I told them to spread the word. I then began to just tell everyone in the place to spread the word of ODIN. I left because it was not the right place for me. I tried to drive out and only made it a mile before I got out of my vehicle in traffic. I was at this time in the threshhold between death and Life. I was in traffic and got hit by a slow moving vehicle. Rolling over the top I managed to land on my feetm Upon landing I must've blew out my knee because I could only take a few steps before I had to take a seat.
The police showed up and I began to go berserk. I fought with the officer. In the end five had put their hands on me. At one point in the struggle a gun was put to the back of my head and I screamed my death song out. I was in the moment of oblivion if I closed my eyes. I understood death as a transition period only and did not fear it coming. I told the officer that I loved him and that he had to do what he must and that I would not give up. I thought I was headed to Valhalla...Than I remember getting choked out. Only had about a 45 min trip.
I was hospitalized and heavily sedated (twice).I came to, fully conscious five hours later. The sedative did not put me to sleep but did black out all memory of anything during the sedatives work on my body. I was in restraints thinking I would surely be in jail soon. It turns out I was admitted under a pseudonym rather than my actual name even though I had my I.D. With me during the fighting. The cops took my bag of amanitas for themselves and let me go. I was only in restraints because of the berserk state I was in. I was let go the next day because I could limp out of there.
When I got to the impound lot to get my vehicle back I could tell it had been searched and my amanitas had vanished. My analysis is that Odin's magick is real and that it is very dangerous to practice it in public.
